release_notes: AC-CLUB-MEMBER-ACTION-01: Fixed silent execution failure on 1-touch member action buttons (Khóa, Mở Khóa, Duyệt Ngay) by defensively initializing pulseMetrics and switching from brittle inline string quotes to data-attributes and dedicated handler dispatchers.
AC-CLUB-MEMBER-ACTION-02: Added seamless state updates for pending member approval with 1-touch [✓ Duyệt Ngay], immediately moving member to Hoạt động and transforming button to [🔒 Khóa].
AC-CLUB-MEMBER-ACTION-03: Resolved 'Invalid Date' display error via robust formatMemberMatrixDate helper and fixed status badge synchronization for pre-locked member (LOCKED/SUSPENDED status).
Refactored backend domain models and in-memory store to normalize member status and synchronize pulse metrics.
